description: Tutorial lesson T4 driven with the SHIPPED pad scheme (PadRouter HINTS_TARGETS): LB claims pad mode, D-pad + A opens the tutorial menu, cursor-glide + A through the picker and the instructor card, then RB cycles the acting unit to the Boyz and Start (menu) is Confirm Targets -- NOT a cursor click on the HUD, because with a shooter armed PadRouter._handle_a assigns the highlighted target before the cursor ever sees A. The resolution dock is driven by cursor-glide + A (no shooter armed at that point, so A falls through to the cursor). The phase summary is an embedded modal Window, so its confirm is emitted.

steps.comment: fresh container / fresh user:// = the first-launch 'First time 'ere?' nudge is up and swallows the pad menu navigation below. Dismiss it if present.
LB claims pad mode so the tutorial renders pad copy and the virtual cursor arms

instructor-card Continue. This glide stalls intermittently under llvmpipe (VirtualCursor advances the glide only while pad mode is held, and the cursor's own warp synthesises mouse motion). The runner now retries a stalled round instead of failing on the first one, so no per-step timeout override is needed.
RB cycles the acting unit - the only unit-selection control on the pad
the lesson clears boot.auto_assign_single_target, so picking the shooter leaves every gun unaimed and the player has an assign step to do

D-pad parks the virtual cursor (VirtualCursor._input park() on any D-pad press). The picker/Continue glides above left it live, and PadRouter._assign_highlighted_target bails while the cursor owns A. Only one target is eligible, so the ring does not move.
D-pad ▼ walks the weapon rows onto the Slugga
A aims the current gun at the highlighted target
▼ to the Warboss's kombi-weapon (attached character - its bearer id is the composite "U_WARBOSS_T:m1")
the kombi-weapon has DEVASTATING WOUNDS, so assigning it opens the attacker-choices dialog - confirm it to commit the assignment
▼ to the Warboss's twin sluggas

steps.script:
var n := 0
for a in PhaseManager.current_phase_instance.pending_assignments:
	n += 1
return n
steps.comment: all three weapons aimed by hand on the pad, including both of the attached Warboss's guns

step 5 pad copy must lead with the Confirm Targets press, not with the re-aim stick controls (main's assertion, kept verbatim - the confirm step still ends with the re-aim hint so the ordering check is still meaningful)
Start means Confirm Targets here, so the top-right button must not also advertise '[☰] End Shooting Phase' - one glyph, one promise
Start = Confirm Targets on the pad (HINTS_TARGETS)

defender save-results card. Whether ANY card appears is seed-dependent: the card only exists when that seed's dice actually wounded something, and a rules fix that changes how many dice are rolled (e.g. RAPID FIRE now correctly counting an attached character within half range) shifts the stream. Driven with real pad input when a card IS up; skipped cleanly when it is not. The later Done presses are already tolerant for the same reason, and step 'has_shot' below is the real gate.
extra defender save cards are seed-dependent - press only if one is up (the first card above is driven with real pad input)
extra defender save cards are seed-dependent - press only if one is up (the first card above is driven with real pad input)
the Dice Log step moved here from T1, where the pad player was glided onto the tab before any dice existed
the rolls the step sends them to read are really in the log by now
glide by node, NOT button_text: the tab's label is 'Dice Log  ●' while there is unread output, and _find_visible_button_by_text matches exactly
no shooter is armed any more, so A falls through to the virtual cursor and clicks the tab
Start is the pad end-phase verb
pad confirm on the end-phase prompt (no-op if the summary opened directly)
the phase summary is an embedded modal Window - the virtual cursor cannot reach it, so emit its confirm
